scope: CPU-only invocation-local reuse of bounded DD tensor/lift/switch buffers. Existing windowed API uses reuse automatically; the normal replay still defaults to independent products unless --dd-windowed1 is supplied. Arithmetic and accuracy requirements are unchanged.
protocol: One retained-key process warms independent/reallocated/reused policies, then measures independent/reallocated/reused/reused/reallocated/independent. Repeat in a second process; four measured samples per policy. All policies share one immutable prepared level-chunk key chain, native automorphism cache and retained input. No second key chain, encryption or key generation.

mode_legend.1: Previous windowed helper: fresh outer buffers per window
mode_legend.2: Updated windowed helper: one local buffer set per invocation

interpretation: In this fixed grouped sparse-Tanh profile, reuse reduces the DD tree stage by4.23% and the full refresh by1.36% relative to the previous windowed path. Against independent products in the same experiment, the reused windowed path reduces tree time14.70% and full refresh3.94%; this latter gain includes windowing and is not attributable to scratch reuse alone. Both processes show the same direction. The second process has no sampled external CPU activity; the first records five activity samples during early setup. No own compilation or tests overlap timing.
fault_count_limit: Integrated DD minor faults average101957 reallocated versus101895.5 reused, only0.06% lower. Thus the much larger component fault reduction does not explain the integrated gain. Source-level redundant initialization/allocation is removed, but no single physical latency cause is proven.
initialization_accounting: For a four-root forest with76/36/20/8/4 products, fresh outer arrays initialize6 polynomials per144 products, while window8 reuse initializes6 per36 retained slots across levels. At N16384 and56 bytes per coefficient, the source-level difference is567MiB of initial outer polynomial storage. This is not a measured DRAM-traffic or total-RSS reduction. Peak workspace remains bounded by8 products; temporaries do not survive the call.
validation: All original, reduced-degree and default-path GeLU/Tanh/Sigmoid output archives match their previous qualified bytes, including the remaining-level square. Exact equality carries forward prior independent phase/slot proofs. Component and scalar/forest/zero-tail checks are recorded in narrow-dd-scratch-reuse-component-validation.json.
generator: make_dd_scratch_replay.py rejects mixed comparison controls and invalid profiles before key loading, refuses an existing experiment directory, and reports per-tree getrusage counters in the diagnostic source only. Its legacy adapter retains the same chain and invokes the frozen pre-change helper; borrowed-view descriptor setup differs slightly from direct chain dispatch and is included in the complete-policy timings.
limits: Two balanced processes, one retained input and one shared CPU host. Per-function qualification is coefficient/precision evidence, not a paired speedup for every function. This change does not promote windowing as a universal default or establish paper parameter/security parity. The10x objective remains open.
